text.tspan: Let's plot this ratio in real time, while transcription is happening, and vary concentration.
hopefully by now you get the intuition that the steeper this trend is on average, the better
we are at distinguishing two similar concentrations by looking at transcription activity alone.
In fact, you can choose a confidence level, and now you can relate the trend's steepness
on average, with decision time. Clearly, a larger concentration difference is easier to tell apart.
Larger absolute concentrations are also easier to distinguish. A faster unbinding rate leads
to faster decisions at any concentration. Slope is limited by the speed of diffusion.
